og.title: FujiMod
og.description: Firmware modified to unlock your camera’s full potential. 23 new features like 65:24 XPan crop, highlight metering, snap focus, unlimited recipes with white balance shift, F-Log video, and touch input in menus. Assign any setting to any control: use the EV dial for ISO, or the auto/manual switch to change film simulation. Try in your browser or dual-boot from an SD card without flashing.
